headline: Will Jabil's (JBL) AI Logistics Hub and Dividend Move Reshape Its Capital Allocation Narrative?
summary: Jabil Inc. has recently declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.08 per share for shareholders of record on August 14, 2026, and opened a next-generation, AI-enabled 417,000-square-foot Intelligent Logistics Hub in Penang to enhance end-to-end material flow and handling of sensitive components. The Penang facility’s extensive automation, digital twin platform, and planned rooftop solar system highlight Jabil’s focus on higher-efficiency, lower-carbon logistics for complex electronics supply...
